## s07 — Ch.5 Beyond the Borders (Lyn's tale, Hard) — WON on turn 11

- **Lost:** Nobody.
- **Gained:** Lyn L5 -> L6 (19 HP). Kent L6 -> L7 (S9 K9 P9) plus the brigand's Iron Sword drop (he now carries two Iron Swords). Florina L1 -> L2 (18 HP). Wil L2 -> L3 (21 HP). Both greens (Erk 10/17, Serra 3/17) survived; neither was recruited (no Talk).
- **What happened:** Objective "Defeat enemy" (rout), 7 enemies. Only the west brigand, the archer at (7,4) and the merc at (8,2) were aggressive; they came at the forest belt around (3-5,4-6) on turns 1-3 and died to Kent's lance, Lyn's Mani Katti (100% vs axes, but only 7 dmg x1 at 67% vs a merc standing in forest) and Kent's finishing lance. The merc hit Serra twice (17 -> 3) before it died on turn 3. The other four were guard-type: Kent baited the (11,0) brigand at (8,2) on turn 5 and killed it turn 6; Kent killed the (14,2) archer from the house at (13,2) with a doubled 12x2 on turn 7 and the merc from (12,7) walked into his counter that enemy phase. Boss (Lv9 brigand, Steel Axe, 29 HP, D8, at (14,9)) never moved: Wil 4 dmg from (14,7) at range 2 with no counter, Lyn 6x2 at 100% from the forest at (14,8) (his hit on her there was 6% displayed / 0.8% true); his enemy-phase swing missed and Lyn's counter left him at 1, Wil finished on turn 11.
- **Sain:** slot #1 (cls28, 19/19, Iron Lance) is listed at Lyn's tile every turn but is NOT selectable (fe7_reachable decodes wrong; the phase ends without him). He is a ghost entry from the s06 death; the real roster is Lyn, Kent, Florina, Wil. Ch.6 still lists him at (4,3) — treat him as absent until proven otherwise.
- **Army (Ch.6 start):** Lyn L6 19/19, Mani Katti 32 (slot 0), Iron Sword 20, Vulnerary 3, Iron Axe 45. Kent L7 24/24, Iron Lance 34 (slot 0), Iron Sword 16, Iron Sword 46, no vulnerary. Florina L2 18/18, Slim Lance 24, Vulnerary 3. Wil L3 21/21, Iron Bow 40, no vulnerary. Game heals between chapters.
- **Learned:** (1) Cavalry and Wil pay 2-3 move per forest here; check fe7_reachable before planning forest tiles for them. (2) The Mani Katti does not double an AS-8 merc and hits it at only 67% in forest; vs brigands and archers it is 100% and doubles. (3) Wil missed three 62-70% shots in a row; do not build a kill around his chip. (4) The boss is stationary; range-2 chip plus Lyn on the forest at (14,8) is a near-zero-risk kill. (5) Killing the last enemy with fe7_act ran straight through the ending into the Ch.6 title card in the same call — no save prompt was seen.
- **Between chapters:** No prompts appeared. Nothing was chosen.
- **Next:** Ch.6 Blood of Pride, turn 1, player phase, opening dialogue (Lyn/Sain in a city) still on screen — use fe7_wait/fe7_unstick first. 0 enemies listed yet, 7 greens (five cls47, a cls51 at (2,5), a cls3C at (0,13)) — the map is a city; read the objective from the opening screenshot after the cutscene. Lyn (4,5), Kent (17,10), Florina (6,5), Wil (2,3). State saved at playthrough/states/s07_ch06_blood-of-pride.ss.

## s08 — Ch.6 Blood of Pride (Lyn's tale, Hard) — WON on turn 12

- **Lost:** Nobody.
- **Gained:** Rath (nomad, cls2E, L7, 25 HP, bow 0x32) joined as player #5 in the opening event; Matthew (thief, cls3C, L2, 18 HP, Iron Sword + Lockpick) joined automatically on turn 3 with no Talk needed. Florina got a Door Key (0x69) from the village at (7,8) and another from the soldier at (16,4) (one used). Matthew opened the chest at (12,6) and holds item 0x5A x1 (unidentified). The chest at (16,1) in the NE room was NOT opened. No level-ups seen.
- **What happened:** Objective "Hit switches" (three switches: (16,7) in the small SE room, (8,1) in the NW room, (12,1) in the boss room). Enemies: 2 mercs and a door soldier were the only movers; everything else was a guard. Turns 1-2 Kent baited both mercs at (8,10) and Kent/Rath/Lyn killed them. Turn 4 Rath doubled the door soldier from range 2 (13x2 kills every soldier here, no counter). Turn 6 Matthew opened the door (16,9) with `fe7_act door` (lockpick use dropped 15->14), Rath killed the room soldier, Kent stepped on (16,7) and the switch opened the big central room (10-17, 4-7; entrance from the west at (9,5)/(9,6)). Turn 8 Florina one-rounded the last soldier at (16,4) (10x2, took 5). Turn 10 Florina used a Door Key on (16,3) and Matthew lockpicked (8,3); Kent on (8,1) opened the boss room (11-13, 0-3). Lyn killed the archer at (12,2) from (12,3) before it could shoot Florina (bows do 22 to her). Boss Bool (knight, 26 HP, D10, Steel Lance 17 dmg to Lyn, never moves): Rath and Wil chipped 3x2 each from (13,2)/(12,3) with no counter for two turns, Kent finished at 99%. Lyn stepped on (12,1) and the chapter ended.
- **Army (Ch.7 start, game heals):** Lyn L6 19 HP, Mani Katti 29 (slot 0), Iron Sword 20, Vulnerary 3, Iron Axe 45. Kent L7 24 HP, Iron Lance ~32 (slot 0), Iron Sword 16, Iron Sword 46. Florina L2 18 HP, Slim Lance 22, Vulnerary 3, Door Key 1. Wil L3 21 HP, Iron Bow 37. Rath L7 25 HP, bow 0x32 x16, Vulnerary 3. Matthew L2 18 HP, Iron Sword 46, Lockpick 12, item 0x5A. The Sain ghost (slot with cls28 19 HP, lance 37) is benched on the prep screen.
- **Learned:** (1) `fe7_act door`/`chest`/`visit` all work; the confirm signal is the lockpick/key use dropping (or the new item appearing) plus a fe7_terrain re-read. (2) A switch fires the moment a unit lands on its tile — the Wait then reports "not confirmed" but the unit is spent and terrain changes; re-read fe7_terrain. Unrevealed rooms read as Roof (0x22). (3) Rath's bow doubles and kills 20-HP soldiers at range 2 with no counter; he is the best tool on this roster. (4) Archers three-fold damage on Florina: never end a turn with her in an archer's danger map. (5) Stationary bosses with D10 are best chipped from range 2 (Rath/Wil 3x2 each per turn) and finished by Kent. (6) The end-of-chapter Save screen highlighted slot 3 ("Ch. 6: Blood of Pride"), not slot 1 (which shows Ch.4); A on it, then A on Save. Ch.7 HAS a Preparations screen.
- **Between chapters:** Saved to game slot 3 (the highlighted one) at the Save prompt; one Start skipped the Ch.7 opening cutscene (Nils) and landed on the Preparations screen.
- **Next:** Ch.7 Siblings Abroad, turn 0, Preparations screen up (objective "Defeat Heintz"; press Start once to begin). 6 deployed: Lyn (3,4), Kent (1,1), Florina (2,2), Wil (4,2), Rath (1,3), Matthew (3,3). 11 enemies: 4 cls24 (probably shamans/dark mages; 22 HP) at (7,10), (5,5), (12,12), (5,11); 3 cls39 at (17,10), (12,4) (DROPS an Iron Lance), (9,13); mercs at (18,6), (13,7); archer at (10,1); a cls20 mage at (14,8). Nils (green, must survive?) may appear — read the objective screenshot. Slots re-sort after prep; re-read fe7_state. State saved at playthrough/states/s08_ch07_siblings-abroad.ss.

## s09 — Ch.7 Siblings Abroad (Lyn's tale, Hard) — WON on turn 13

- **Lost:** Nobody.
- **Gained:** Lucius (monk, cls1C, L3, 18 HP, Lightning 0x3E x35, Res 6) joined on turn 1 as player #8 (appeared at (2,5) after the first moves). Nils (bard, cls41, 14 HP, only a Vulnerary) was deployed all chapter and never touched. Kent L7 -> L8 (25 HP, S10) plus the fighter's Iron Lance drop (he now carries two Iron Lances and two Iron Swords). Rath L7 -> L8 (26 HP). Wil L3 -> L4. Lyn and Florina no level. The village at (17,2) was destroyed by a fighter before Florina could reach it (turn 6; it reads as Ruins now, Visit was not offered).
- **What happened:** Objective "Defeat Heintz" (Lv5 shaman, 22 HP, D3 R5, Flux 1-2, on the Gate at (7,10); he never moved and gets D5/avo 37 on the gate). The start pocket (NW) is sealed from the south by peaks; the only exits are the bridge at (13,5) into mountains (infantry only) and the east bridge (17,4) then down the east edge, which has cliffs at (15,6)/(16,7)/(17,8). Turn 1 Kent killed the nearest shaman (11x2). Turns 3-5: a fighter, an archer, a merc and another fighter walked into the pocket one or two at a time and died to Wil chip + Kent/Lyn finishes and Rath's 10x2 on the archer. Turn 6 Rath doubled a fighter on the village. Turns 6-8 Kent baited the merc at (13,4), Rath baited the mage at (16,6) and the shaman at (16,9): each attacked him and died on his counter. Turns 9-11 the group crossed the east bridge and staged east of the gate; the last shaman came to Kent on the fort at (10,9) and Kent killed it on turn 12 from (9,9). Turn 12 Rath 8 from (9,10) and Florina 5 from (7,11) chipped the boss; on the enemy phase he hit Florina to 6 and Rath's counter left him at 6; turn 13 Rath's 9 at 80% killed him.
- **Army (Ch.7x start, game heals):** Lyn L6 19 HP, Mani Katti 28 (slot 0), Iron Sword 20, Vulnerary 3, Iron Axe 45. Kent L8 25 HP, Iron Lance 24 (slot 0), Iron Sword 16, Iron Sword 46, Iron Lance 45. Florina L2 18 HP, Slim Lance 20, Vulnerary 3, Door Key 1. Wil L4 21 HP, Iron Bow 31. Rath L8 26 HP, bow 0x32 x6 (nearly out — 6 uses left), Vulnerary 3. Matthew L2 18 HP, Iron Sword 46, Lockpick 12, item 0x5A. Nils L1 14 HP, Vulnerary 3. Lucius L3 18 HP, Lightning 35. Sain ghost still benched.
- **Learned:** (1) Rath's bow (0x32) is down to 6 uses; save it for kills that need range, and use Wil's Iron Bow (31) for chip. (2) Guard-type enemies here wake only when a unit ends inside their move+range; a cavalier on a tile the danger map shows as reachable by ONE enemy is a free kill via counter — except a lance cannot counter a range-2 shaman, so bait shamans with Rath (bow counters at 2) or accept one free hit. (3) Boss on a gate: no doubling (AS 7), D5, avo 37; each of Rath/Florina/Kent gets ~78% true for 8/5/13, and his counter is 8 (Res 2 units) or 6 (Florina). Never leave a unit under 9 HP adjacent to him. (4) fe7_reachable before planning cavalry moves near forests, forts and cliffs: forest cost 3, fort 2, cliffs impassable. (5) The boss kill ran straight into the Ch.7x title card in the same fe7_act call, then one Start from the map view landed on the Preparations screen. No save prompt appeared.
- **Between chapters:** No prompts appeared. Nothing was chosen. Ch.7x has a Preparations screen.
- **Next:** Ch.7x The Black Shadow, turn 0, Preparations screen up (objective "Defeat enemy" = rout; press Start once to begin). 8 deployed in the south: Lyn (12,14), Kent (7,16), Florina (13,14), Wil (10,14), Rath (11,15), Matthew (12,16), Nils (8,15), Lucius (9,16). 12 enemies: Lv7 merc boss (24 HP, sword 0x03 = Steel?) at (2,1) with a thief (2,2) and a soldier (1,2) beside him; soldiers (cls38, 20 HP, D0) at (12,9) and (3,12) (the latter DROPS a Vulnerary); mercs at (8,2), (11,2); fighters at (7,8), (4,4); archer (3,7); mage (10,7) with Thunder 0x38 and a Door Key; a cavalier (cls28, 20 HP, D6, lance+sword) at (14,1). The map is an indoor fortress (dark map; last session's Ch.7x notes in the earlier logs mention walls that ranged units shoot through). Slots re-sort after prep; re-read fe7_state. Nils must not die — keep him at the back. State saved at playthrough/states/s09_ch07x_the-black-shadow.ss.

## s10 — Ch.7x The Black Shadow (Lyn's tale, Hard) — WON on turn 15

- **Lost:** Nobody. Nils never touched.
- **Gained:** Wil L4 -> L5 (22 HP, S8 K7 P7). Kent L8 -> L9 (26 HP). Florina L2 -> L3 (19 HP) from the boss kill. Kent picked up the soldier's Vulnerary drop (used up during the map). The enemy thief looted the chest at (3,9) (item 0x26) and vanished on turn 5, so the chest is lost. No other drops.
- **What happened:** Objective "Defeat enemy" (rout), 12 enemies + 2 caster reinforcements (mage and shaman from the NW room on turn 3). The south start pocket connects north only through the column-7 corridor ((7,5)-(7,12)) and, via row 11, the east column 14. Nearly everything was aggressive and came to us: Kent at the corridor mouth (7,13) counter-killed a soldier and a fighter on turn 1, Lyn at (12,14) counter-killed the cavalier with the Mani Katti on turn 2 (took 11), Rath at (13,13) counter-killed the mage on turn 3. Soldiers broke the walls at (8,8) and (13,8). Turns 5-8: Wil doubled two soldiers (13x2, no counter) and chipped the archer from range 2 in the corridor with Kent as the plug; Kent killed the mage and shaman at (7,7)/(7,6). Turns 11-12: Kent baited both mercs from (8,3) and he and Florina finished them. Boss (Lv7 merc, 24 HP, D5, Steel Sword, at (2,1), never moved): Rath 9x2 from the doorway (2,3) on turn 14, Florina 6 from (2,2) on turn 15.
- **Army (Ch.8 start, game heals):** Lyn L6 19 HP, Mani Katti 26 (slot 0), Iron Sword 20, Vulnerary 2, Iron Axe 45. Kent L9 26 HP, Iron Lance 11 (slot 0), Iron Sword 16, Iron Sword 46, Iron Lance 45, NO vulnerary. Florina L3 19 HP, Slim Lance 19, Vulnerary 3, Door Key 1. Wil L5 22 HP, Iron Bow 23. Rath L8 26 HP, bow 0x32 x2 (almost gone), Vulnerary 3. Lucius L3 18 HP, Lightning 35 (never fought). Nils L1 14 HP. Matthew L2 18 HP (benched on the Ch.8 prep screen along with the Sain ghost — only 7 deployed).
- **Learned:** (1) A cavalier plugging a one-wide corridor with a bow archer behind him clears this map with zero risk: Wil's 13x2 kills every 20-HP soldier from range 2 with no counter. (2) Casters are the only real damage here (7-9 per hit, ignore Def); kill them on the player phase with Kent's 12x2, never leave a unit under 15 HP in their range. (3) The route to the NW boss room is long — centre room (7,2) -> (6,2) -> column 5 -> (5,4) -> (4,4),(3,4),(2,4) -> door (2,3); monk/infantry need three turns, and fe7_act refuses moves beyond Move rather than partial-moving, so check fe7_reachable for infantry first. (4) A stationary boss with only a sword dies to range-2 attackers with zero risk; Rath's 9x2 then any finisher. (5) Lucius doubles most things here (AS 10) and Lightning ignores Def, but he never got in range — use him earlier next map. (6) The thief escapes with chest loot if not killed by about turn 5.
- **Between chapters:** No save prompt appeared. Nothing was chosen. The boss kill ran straight into the Ch.8 title card; one Start from there landed on the Ch.8 Preparations screen.
- **Next:** Ch.8 Vortex of Strategy, turn 0, Preparations screen up (objective "Defeat enemy" = rout) with a tutorial dialogue box ("Ah, Lady Lyndis! Claude!") still showing over the menu — screenshot/fe7_unstick first; it may need A before Start starts the chapter. 7 deployed in the NW corner: Lyn (2,2), Kent (0,1), Florina (1,2), Wil (2,1), Rath (2,3), Nils (3,1), Lucius (3,3); Matthew is benched (cannot be fixed with the tools). 14 enemies: cls14 boss? (25 HP) at (12,15); soldiers (7,15),(8,15),(11,14); fighters (13,16),(13,14); cavaliers (8,13),(7,13); mercs (4,11),(11,16); archers (9,8),(11,10); mage (13,5); shaman (13,4). Rath has 2 bow uses left — Wil is the ranged unit now. State saved at playthrough/states/s10_ch08_vortex-of-strategy.ss.

## s11 — Ch.8 Vortex of Strategy (Lyn's tale, Hard) — WON on turn 16

- **Lost:** Nobody. Nils never touched. Closest call: Lyn baited the last fighter (Steel Axe) at (11,15) and took 15 of her 19 HP in one hit — she hit it once, not twice, and was left at 4.
- **Gained:** Lucius L3 -> L5 (20 HP, S8 R7) — he killed the mage, two cavaliers-worth of kills, both fighters, the boss (a 6% crit at range 2) and the last fighter. Florina L3 -> L4. Rath's bow broke on turn 2 (counter-killed the shaman with the last two uses), so Rath is WEAPONLESS and was a body for the rest of the map. Nothing dropped, no chests, the village at (13,3) was never visited.
- **What happened:** Objective "Defeat enemy" (rout), 14 enemies + 3 soldier reinforcements from the south edge (turns 3-4). The NW start pocket is walled by cliffs; only rows 4-7 cols 0-4 and the column-3 forest path lead south. Everything aggressive came to us: turn 2 Lucius killed the mage at range 2, Rath's counter killed the shaman; turn 3 Wil finished the merc, Lucius and Kent killed both cavaliers; turn 4 Lucius/Kent killed a soldier and the archer; turns 5-7 Kent baited and counter-killed the reinforcement soldiers one at a time (18x2 with a fresh Iron Lance, 100% vs Def 0). A fighter wandered from the village to a cliff pocket at (6,7) that only fliers reach; it walked out to (4,4) and Lucius killed it. The four SE enemies (boss, soldier, merc, fighter) were guards: soldier and merc walked onto the bridge at (8,14) once someone stood at (8,13) and died there; the fighter and boss never moved until baited. Boss (Lv6 Knight, 25 HP, Def 11, Steel Lance, at (12,15), 1-range): Lucius 10x2 from (10,15) — the second blow crit and killed him.
- **Army (Ch.9 start, game heals):** Lyn L6 19 HP, Mani Katti 25 (slot 0), Iron Sword 20, Vulnerary 2, Iron Axe 45. Kent L9 26 HP, Iron Lance 37 (slot 0), Iron Lance 1, Iron Sword 16, Iron Sword 46, NO vulnerary. Florina L4 19 HP, Slim Lance 15, Vulnerary 2, Door Key 1. Wil L5 22 HP, Iron Bow 24. Rath L8 26 HP, NO WEAPON, Vulnerary 3. Nils L1 14 HP. Lucius L5 20 HP, Lightning 24. Matthew L2 18 HP, Iron Sword 46, Lockpick 12 (deployed this chapter). Sain ghost still benched.
- **Learned:** (1) Lucius is the best unit on the team now: Lightning ignores Def, he doubles everything with AS<=6, and at range 2 nothing here counters — put him where a range-2 tile exists and forecast first. (2) ALWAYS forecast before a range-1 finish: Florina's "safe finisher" on a 7-HP merc was 5x1 at 63% against a 9-dmg, 98% counter. (3) Lyn as bait is not free: the Steel Axe fighter hit her for 15 at a displayed 23%; never bait the lord with anything that can do >half her HP. (4) fe7_threat's counts include guards that will never move; a guard at range 1 of your tile still attacks. (5) Cavalry cannot enter the row-4/5/6 cliffs or the (6,7)-(7,7) pocket; fe7_reachable before every cavalier move on this map. (6) The boss kill ran straight into the Ch.9 title card; one Start landed on the Preparations screen with a "Seize gate" objective and no save prompt.
- **Between chapters:** No prompts appeared. Nothing was chosen. Ch.9 has a Preparations screen.
- **Next:** Ch.9 A Grim Reunion, turn 0, Preparations screen up (objective "Seize gate"; press Start once to begin, then re-read fe7_state because slots re-sort). 8 deployed in the west: Lyn (1,8), Kent (2,6), Florina (2,11), Wil (0,9), Rath (3,7), Nils (3,6), Lucius (1,10), Matthew (2,10). 5 enemies: boss cls2A (30 HP, D10, weapons 0x1C and 0x28) at (17,13) with soldiers at (16,14) and (18,14); a cls0E (16 HP, Iron Sword) at (13,3); merc at (10,9). Wallace is expected to join on this chapter in the real game — watch for a green or new player unit. Rath has no weapon; Kent is the only vulnerary-less front-liner. State saved at playthrough/states/s11_ch09_a-grim-reunion.ss.

## s12 — Ch.9 A Grim Reunion (Lyn's tale, Hard) — WON on turn 24

- **Lost:** Nobody. Closest calls: Lucius took 16 from two archers on one enemy phase (down to 4/21, no vulnerary) and sat out the rest of the map; Kent sat at 10/27 from turn 4 on with no vulnerary.
- **Gained:** Wallace (Knight L12, 30 HP, D15, Iron Lance, Iron Axe, Knight Crest) joined at the start of turn 2 and carried the map. Lyn L6 -> L8, Lucius L5 -> L6, Wallace L12 -> L13, Kent L9 -> L10. Lyn visited the village at (1,5) and got a 5-use item 0x6F (Torch, probably) — `fe7_act action:'visit'` works (inventory delta is the signal). Nothing dropped.
- **What happened:** Fog-of-war seize map, 5 visible enemies at start plus ~13 reinforcements over turns 1-4 (brigands from the SW fort (1,13/1,14) and the mountain fort (6,5)/(7,5), soldiers from the north edge (4,0)/(5,0), cavaliers/archers from the east (12,7)). Held the west bank of the bridge at (6,10): Kent then weaponless Rath plugged (5,10) (only the bridge tile can reach it), Lucius at (4,10) doubled everything that stepped onto the bridge from range 2 (2 brigands, 2 cavaliers, both archers on counters), Wil/Lyn/Wallace killed the brigands and soldiers that came round the north and south. Reinforcements stopped after turn 4. Then a slow march east: rows 8-10 are the only corridor, forests cost cavalry 3. Gate guards (2 soldiers) walked to Wallace and died on counters; the boss (Eagler, Paladin, 30 HP, Def 12 on the gate, Javelin + Hand Axe, NEVER moves, heals 3/turn on the gate) was chipped by Wallace from (17,14) — 47% hit, missed 5 straight — then Lyn's Mani Katti (effective vs cavalry: 11x2 at 95%, 12% counter for 14) killed him at 12 HP. Seized turn 24.
- **Army (Ch.10 start, game heals):** Lyn L8 21 HP, Mani Katti 21, Iron Sword 20, Vulnerary 2, Iron Axe 45, item 0x6F x5. Kent L10 27 HP, Iron Lance 32 (slot 0), Iron Lance 1, Iron Sword 16, Iron Sword 46, NO vulnerary. Florina L4 19 HP, Slim Lance 15, Vulnerary 2, Door Key. Wil L5 22 HP, Iron Bow 20. Rath L8 26 HP, NO WEAPON, Vulnerary 2. Nils L1 14 HP, Vulnerary 3. Lucius L6 21 HP, Lightning 11 (running low), NO vulnerary. Matthew L2 18 HP, Iron Sword 46, Lockpick 12. Wallace L13 31 HP, Iron Lance 28, Iron Axe 45, Vulnerary 2, Knight Crest. Sain ghost still benched.
- **Learned:** (1) A one-tile chokepoint plus a weaponless high-HP body on it plus Lucius two tiles behind is a zero-risk meat grinder; enemies still step onto the bridge one at a time. (2) Weapon uses only drop on HITS, so the enemy-phase "used" list is a hit log, not an action log. (3) Gate boss heals 3 HP/turn and gets +2 Def; bring one Wallace hit past the heal before committing Lyn. (4) The stationary boss's real attack tiles were only the five within range 2 of the gate through the wall gaps — fe7_threat's boss reach was a large over-claim because it never moves. (5) fe7_threat verify=0 could not open the boss's grid (fog). (6) fe7_wait's Start/A alternation after the world map pressed straight through into Ch.10 turn 1 — if Ch.10 had a Preparations screen it was skipped by the tool, not chosen.
- **Between chapters:** A save-slot screen appeared (slot 3 "Ch. 9: A Grim Reunion" highlighted) then a Save/Quit sub-prompt with Save highlighted; chose the highlighted slot and Save both times. Screenshot 2026-09-19_s12_ch09_end_save-slot.png. No title card screenshot was captured — fe7_wait ran through it.
- **Next:** Ch.10 (Lyn's tale finale, "The Distant Plains" presumably), turn 1, player phase, objective "Seize gate", no prep screen showing. 9 deployed in the NW: Lyn (4,3), Kent (1,1), Florina (1,2), Wil (2,2), Rath (2,3), Nils (3,2), Lucius (3,4), Matthew (4,1), Wallace (4,5). 11 enemies: boss cls16 (35 HP, D14, Silver Lance? 0x17 + Javelin) at (2,16) with a knight cls14 (18 HP, D9) at (2,17); brigand (1,9); soldier (14,3); cls20 mage? (15,2, tome 0x37); cls24 (15,14, weapon 0x44 — a staff/status user?); archers (14,8),(7,13),(16,4); mercs (8,9),(9,10). Rath still has no weapon, Lucius has 11 Lightning uses, Kent and Lucius have no vulnerary. State saved at playthrough/states/s12_ch10_the-distant-plains.ss.
